commits_data.title: SMB2: fix dissecting device number
commits_data.message:
SMB2: fix dissecting device number

This field contains the device number, not a "file_id".

Cf [RFC-SMB3-UNIX] section 3.1.1

https://codeberg.org/SMB3UNIX/smb3_posix_spec/releases/download/0.3/smb3_posix_extensions.pdf

Signed-off-by: Ralph Boehme <slow@samba.org>
